BLUSTAKE Admin

Private administration for the authorized account only. Registration and transaction information is restricted to admin access.

Credit or deduct a user's wallet

Find the registered user by email address or phone number, then credit or deduct their GH₵ wallet. Every adjustment is recorded in the wallet ledger. Only the verified admin can use this control.

Settle a finished bet

Use only after the match result has been verified and the match is marked finished. This calls the secure Supabase settlement function, which updates the bet, selections, wallet and ledger together.

Each bet has its own short reference. Full UUIDs are also accepted.

Create and manage BLUSTAKE fixtures. Created fixtures use the same match-card layout as the main list. Admin-created match simulations should not be mistaken for independently verified real-world fixtures.

Apply the supplied Supabase SQL migration before creating fixtures. Match clock, score events and markets are stored centrally so signed-in accounts see the same state.

H = home goal, A = away goal. The configured events should add up to the target score. Match timing: 45 minutes, 15-minute half-time break, then 45 minutes.
